== == =
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : None
 For the Respondent/s : Mr. Dhurjati Kumar Prasad, Gp-14
 For Nhai : Mr. Sriram Krishna, Adv.
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Rajiv Roy
 Oral Order
No one appears on behalf of the petitioner though State as also NHAI are present.

2. The present application has been preferred:
for issuance of a writ, order or direction including a writ in the nature of Mandamus,
commanding the respondents to pay full payment, which was granted by the Land Acquisition Department, against the acquisition of land of Khata No. 80, Plot No.
2568, 2569 area 0.2057 acres and 0.3255 acres (department granted Rs.1793704/-
and Rs.2838360/- respectively and lastly 1/2 of the same was illegally paid to one stranger Smt. Kumkum Devi wife of Yogeshwar Patna High Court CWJC No.24155 of 2018(2) dt.06-01-2026 Prasad Singh in spite of submission of family arrangement/partition between family in 1999.
And also a writ in the nature of Bhuneshwar Prasad Singh, vs The State Of Bihar on 6 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/50572277/

entities.text: Bhuneshwar Prasad Singh, vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 Certiorari may kindly be issued for quashing the illegal payment order dated 28.08.18 passed by respondent no.03 or be pleased to pass such other order/s as Your Lordships may deem fit and proper.
3. A counter affidavit has come on behalf of the State respondents according to which, late Yogeshwar Prasad Singh is/was not a stranger rather own brother of the writ petitioner.
Having left for his heavenly abode, his wife, Smt. Kumkum Devi was entitled to half of the share of the land in question and in that background, the compensation amount was rightly granted to her.
As recorded above, the fact has come by way of counter affidavit in the year 2022 and there is no rebuttal to it.
4. This Court is satisfied that the respondents have acted bonafidely in the matter and no case is made out.
5. However, since there is no appearance, dismissed for non-prosecution.

(Rajiv Roy, J) Vijay Singh/-
